blocks.text: Silver Valley homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Silver Valley, September 2026. Detached houses: 49 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 15 listed at month end and 0 sold in September, a sales ratio of —.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 29 sold over 4 months against an average of 55.0 listed, about 7.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 13 sold. Condos and townhomes: 10 sold over 4 months against an average of 13.2 listed, about 5.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 5 sold.

faq.q: How did Silver Valley sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 49 active listings, 5 solds and a 10% sales ratio — joint with Albion — and Condos & Townhomes recorded 15 listings with no sale (ratio NA). Medians are published at community level only (Maple Ridge detached $1,131,000; attached $525,000), and those community figures are not Silver Valley's own (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

The City of Maple Ridge Official Community Plan (Bylaw 7998-2024, adopted June 25, 2024) and the Silver Valley Area Plan, whose update Council adopted November 25, 2025; zoning is under Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 — confirm a parcel's designation and zone with the City before relying on either.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Silver Valley?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 49 houses listed with 5 sold in the month and 15 condos and townhomes listed with 0 sold in the month in Silver Valley. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Silver Valley a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 10%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
